info.title: PH Courier & Logistics API
info.description: Backend-only courier platform. Money uses integer paisa (100 paisa = 1 BDT). CUSTOMER, COURIER, ADMIN roles. Stripe is the only payment source. Reload shipment versions after HTTP 409.
